Sustainabox Community

Join a network of builders, designers, and entrepreneurs building resilient housing and alternative homes.

What You Get

Expert Office Hours

Monthly video calls with Cody. Bring your questions, get feedback, solve problems together.

Member-Only Resources

Templates, checklists, design guides, cost data, and lessons learned. Everything learned from the Sustainabox build.

Private Community Forum

Ask questions, share progress, get feedback from peers. 24/7 access to the collective knowledge of everyone building.

Exclusive Discounts

10% off the cohort-based course. Early access to new products and templates.

Design Feedback

Share your project. Get constructive feedback from other builders and the instructor. Learn from others' mistakes.

Peer Network

Connect with builders, designers, engineers, and vendors. Share referrals and recommendations. Build relationships that last.

How It Works

  1. Join as a member. $30/month or $300/year.
  2. Get instant access. Forum, resources, upcoming office hour dates.
  3. Participate. Ask questions, share progress, get feedback. Monthly office hours.
  4. Stay connected. Keep learning even after your project is done. Help others.

Who's Here

First-time container home builders. Architects exploring alternative housing. Construction companies diversifying into resilient design. Engineers and designers. Investors looking at this space. Anyone building or thinking about building differently.

Why Join

Avoid Mistakes

Learn from others' experience. Catch issues before they become expensive.

Save Time

Access real templates and frameworks. Don't reinvent the wheel.

Build Relationships

Network with peers and professionals in this space. Collaborations happen here.

Keep Learning

New resources, new members with new experiences. The collective knowledge keeps growing.
